text.en: Asha's teacher held up a thin book. "This guides the whole country," she said.

The Constitution of India is the supreme law. It was drafted by the Constituent Assembly, with Dr B. R. Ambedkar as chairman of the Drafting Committee, adopted on 26 November 1949 and came into force on 26 January 1950, celebrated as Republic Day.
The Preamble declares India a sovereign, socialist, secular, democratic republic and promises justice, liberty, equality and fraternity. The Fundamental Rights are guaranteed by the Constitution, and Directive Principles guide the government.
Fundamental Duties remind citizens of their responsibilities. The Constitution can be amended, and the basic structure cannot be changed. India has a federal structure with a strong centre.

prompt.en: A friend says The Constitution came into force on 15 August 1947. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: It came into force on 26 January 1950.
